title: Performance Marketing Executive
description: LocationChennai, Tamil Nadu Full job description Role: Performance Marketing Executive Experience: 2- 8 years Location: Chennai Key Responsibilities: Campaign Execution & Optimization: Manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, and LinkedIn to achieve business goals (e.g., customer acquisition, lead generation). Performance Analysis: Track and analyze campaign performance metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, and conversion rates using tools like Google Analytics and Facebook Ads Manager. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Conduct A/B tests on ads, creatives, landing pages, and audience segments to continuously improve performance and drive better results. Budget Management: Oversee and optimize marketing budgets across channels, ensuring effective allocation and maximum ROI for all paid campaigns. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the creative, content, and product teams to align on campaign messaging, design, and strategy. Reporting & Insights: Provide regular performance reports to stakeholders, including actionable insights and recommendations to enhance campaign outcomes. Customer Acquisition & Conversion: Drive customer acquisition strategies through paid media while focusing on optimizing conversion rates across funnels. Market Trend Awareness: Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, and platform updates to leverage new strategies for campaign growth. Tool Proficiency: Utilize marketing tools like Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and other performance tracking platforms to manage campaigns and analyze results.
